क्या Rocking Star Yash बॉक्स ऑफिस पर फिर से कोई बड़ा धमाका करने वाले हैं? 🔥

Toxic के फ्लॉप होने के बाद अब Yash अपनी अगली बड़ी फिल्म Ramayana के साथ ग्रैंड वापसी कर रहे हैं। फिल्म के इंटरनेशनल स्क्रीनिंग्स से शुरुआती रिस्पॉन्स काफी पॉजिटिव आया है।

Yash ने KGF Chapter 1 के साथ कर्नाटक में 135.36 crore कमाकर Sandalwood के लिए पहला 100 crore क्लब खोला था। इसके बाद KGF Chapter 2 ने कर्नाटक में रिकॉर्डतोड़ 182.96 crore का कलेक्शन किया।

फिलहाल Rishab Shetty ने Kantara (183.6 crore) और Kantara Chapter 1 (247.48 crore) के साथ Yash के दो 100 crore फिल्मों के रिकॉर्ड की बराबरी कर ली है। 💥

अगर Ramayana को अच्छा वर्ड ऑफ माउथ मिलता है, तो Yash कर्नाटक में तीन 100 crore ग्रॉसर देने वाले पहले एक्टर बन सकते हैं। 🎬

क्या आपको लगता है कि Yash फिल्म Ramayana से नया इतिहास रच पाएंगे? कमेंट्स में बताइए! 👇

ctx.title: Box Office: Can Yash Make History By Becoming The First Star To Deliver Three 100 Crore Grossers In Karnataka?
ctx.summary:
With Yash playing Ravana, the upcoming magnum opus, Ramayana, will be looking forward to a record business at the Karnataka box office. 
 The post  Box Office: Can Yash Make History By Becoming The First Star To Deliver Three 100 Crore Grossers In Karnataka?  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The countdown has started, and the excitement for Ramayana is already high! The early reactions from the international screening are out, and most of them are positive. The magnum opus is an important film for all those associated, especially for Yash, who returns to the big screen after the debacle of Toxic. With this film, he’ll be looking to make box-office history in his home state of Karnataka. Keep reading for a detailed report!
The Rocking Star has established himself as a big star of Indian cinema with KGF Chapter 2. With the historic success of KGF Chapter 2 , the actor’s fan following has increased manifold, especially in Karnataka. Since he’s consistently trying to put the Kannada film industry on the global stage, everyone is excited to see how his upcoming magnum opus performs in his home state.
Yash was the first to open the gates of the 100 crore club for Sandalwood in Karnataka. His KGF Chapter 1 was the first Kannada film to score a century in the state, grossing a huge 135.36 crore . It was followed by KGF Chapter 2, which amassed a massive 182.96 crore . His last release, Toxic, unfortunately failed to enter the 100 crore club, but with Ramayana, he’ll be looking to score his third 100 crore grosser in the state.
Post-KGF, things changed drastically for Sandalwood from a box-office perspective. The KGF franchise showcased the state’s real potential, a trend carried forward by the Kantara franchise. Yash was joined by Rishab Shetty, who has two 100-crore grossers in Karnataka: Kantara ( 183.6 crore ) and Kantara Chapter 1 ( 247.48 crore ). With this, Rishab has tied Yash’s record for the most 100-crore grossers in the state.
With Ramayana carrying genuine buzz on the ground level, it is expected to score big, and given Yash’s presence, it is expected to do well in his home state. All it needs is good word-of-mouth, which will make its entry into the 100 crore club possible in the state. So, the Rocking Star has a chance to become the first star to deliver three 100 crore grossers in Karnataka.
